xyzmMode.description: The XYZM mode to use for serialization, which determines the dimensionality of the points. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

buffer.description: The ByteBuffer where the serialized MultiPoint will be written. Default to get ByteBuffer.allocate method for 1024 bytes if not specified This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
